title: MV Are there any plugins that would allow me to get an item get popup like this?

posts.author: ambr_
posts.body: I have tried several plugins but they're not to my liking, all of them display the popup above the event itself, and not at the bottom of the screen. It may have been possible if I tweaked the plugins themselves but I do not know how to do that. The game shown here is made on VX Ace, but I'm sure there's something similar for MV as well.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Maybe this one?
(MV & MZ) Aero's Gab Windows
A friend of mine asked me if I could make a Gab Window plugin for him, and although there should be many out there, I thought this would be a fun task to do!  Gab Windows are text windows that you can dynamically put on the game screen, whether they are part of the game’s HUD or a speech bubble...

As far as I understand, it should show the window automatically whenever you gain an item via an event command so long as the corresponding switch you've set in the plugin parameters is turned on. By default that's switch 104, but you can change it.
That other stuff shouldn't need to be tweaked if you just wanted to keep it simple.
